_how_to: Copy this file to looks/<id>.json, set "id" to the file name, edit the values, delete what you do not change. Keys starting with "_" are comments (ignored by the tools). Check with `python3 tools/looks.py`, look at it with `python3 tools/looks.py preview <id>`, use it with `"look": "<id>"` in plan.json or series/<slug>/look.json. Full list of keys: docs/LOOKS.md.
description: One line: the mood of this look and what kind of video it is for.
_bg: The set. top / bottom: the wall gradient (keep them dark or mid-tone: captions are white). light / light2: the two drifting coloured lights. dust: number of floating specks. spot: strength of the stage spotlight (0..1.5). floor / grid: true or false.
_accent: accent: THE colour of the look (accent word of the captions, progress bar, the object the video is about). accentAlt: the second colour (danger, contrast).
_fonts: Installed families: Anton, Bebas Neue, Archivo Black, DM Serif Display (display); Inter, Space Grotesk (text); JetBrains Mono (mono). Another family needs an @fontsource import in src/Root.tsx.
_kit: How the kit parts (src/kit) are drawn: extra colours, stroke widths, corner radii, depth of the shadow side.
